title: SLP 2 writing: email and short report checklist
summary: Ten things to check before you hand in a writing task.
body:
Use this list for every writing task, in class and in the exam.

## Task
- Have I answered **every** point in the instructions?
- Is the register right (formal email, informal note, report)?
- Am I close to the word count?

## Organisation
- Clear opening: why am I writing?
- One idea per paragraph.
- Linkers: however, as a result, in addition, finally.
- Clear closing: what happens next / what do I need?

## Language
- Past, present and future used correctly.
- No repeated words in every line — vary your vocabulary.
- Check spelling of names, dates and numbers.
